import_repair_note: Bool's only removal in the tracked window is `Cost` in r2024.09, and it is not about Bool at all. COST LOGIC REMOVED, r2024.09 (commit 41c2667f, 'This diff removes the cost logic'; first tag containing it is r2024.09). EasyCrypt had a complexity subsystem -- `schema` declarations over `cost[P: e]` -- and it was deleted wholesale, both the library side (the `Cost` abstract theories and their `c*` / `ge0_c*` operators) and the ENGINE side: `cost` and `schema` were removed from src/ecLexer.mll's keyword table. That last part decides what the failure looks like. A pre-r2024.09 proof carrying cost annotations does not fail with an unknown symbol, it fails with a PARSE ERROR, because `schema` is no longer a token. There is no replacement API and no rewrite that preserves the annotation: the repair is to delete the cost schemas and any lemma that mentions `cost[...]`. Nothing else in the proof needs to change -- the cost logic was, in the commit's own words, 'barely used'. Setting that aside, Bool has been purely additive since r2022.04: any other unresolved Bool name is a missing require or a rename, not a move.
